repo._local_path_note: REQUIRED for report.mjs and the 24/7 timer scripts (devloop-tick.sh/watchdog.sh read the repo path from their own CLI argument, not from here — but report.mjs and doctor.sh's repo.local_path cross-check use this). /autodev:init detects this via `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` and writes it for you.

runner._note: Per-machine paths for the 24/7 timer (ops/launchd-timer.md). Defaults are already home-relative (~) so they resolve correctly on any machine without editing — only override if you want the timer's state somewhere else.

tracker._instance_label_note: Optional. Overrides tracker.instance_label from deployment.json for THIS machine/operator only — e.g. running two autoDev instances against the same shared board from different runners. Leave empty to use the project default in deployment.json.
tracker._token_file_note: Optional. Overrides the default ~/.config/autodev/<client_name>.<tracker>.token convention with an explicit path. Leave empty to use the default.
